text: __NOTOC__ Screech is an ability for Hunters to teach their pets. It does physical damage to a single target and applies a debuff that lowers the attack power of all nearby enemies. The AoE debuff of screech has an innate threat value built into it, making Screech a powerful tool for pet-tanking multiple mobs. Allow 4 applications of Screech, and then nearby targets can be shot with a Hunter's Multi-Shot without getting aggro.
Screechflight Talons drop from Screechflight Snatchers and Screechflight Cursewives in the Bluefeather Cliffs in Thaldraszus.

__NOTOC__ Scroll of Strength V is created with Inscription (265); taught by trainers. This item can be purchased for from in Terokkar Forest and on Darkmoon Island. This item can be looted from most level 56-73 Humanoid monsters. This item is a quest reward from Unfinished Business (Alliance).
Sea Gulls are seagull critters that can be found in Stormwind City, Darkmoon Island, Frostwall, Krasarang Wilds, Talador, and Tanaris.

The Seabolt is one of three Alliance battleships used by the Kirin Tor Offensive to lay claim to the Isle of Thunder. She is anchored south of Za'Tual in Backbreaker Bay between Rhonin's Beard and Spellsails and is the Kirin Tor Offensive base of operations until it wins Shaol'mara on the isle's southeastern side. Adventurers of the Alliance wishing to help the Kirin Tor Offensive claim the isle can teleport here from the Alliance camp at north of the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes. While on the isle, the Teleport to the Seabolt object is found at on a secluded part of the beach of Za'Tual. There is also a rope ladder hanging from the starboard side of the ship. The Seal of the Sun King is a defense mechanism for the city of Ramkahen and a holy site in Uldum located just north of the city. When the barrier around Uldum fell, Wastewander bandits stole the relics which powered the system while traveling west. Sun Priest Iset attempted to defend the ruins, but was poisoned by the bandits using the local Venomblood Scorpids venom.

, Khaz'goroth, Eonar, Aman'Thul, Aggramar, Norgannon, and Argus in the center.]] The Seat of the Pantheon was described as the "very cradle of creation". It is seemingly where the titan Pantheon met in ages past, and possibly where they focused their powers to organize and shape entire worlds. Argus the Unmaker, the world-soul of the planet Argus, was brought here by the titans to sever its connection to the Burning Legion once and for all. The Pantheon pooled their power with Argus' and imprisoned their former brother Sargeras within the Seat, apparently crippling the Legion and ending the Burning Crusade forever. __NOTOC__ Selis Silksong is a high elf located in the Lower City in Shattrath City. She is found sitting by a tree stump in the north eastern part of the city. She provides Selis' Silk Shirt for 1 copper.

__NOTOC__ Serena Windfeather is a night elf of the Moon Guard located in Moonfall Roost in Suramar. She and the guard were attacked and injured by nightborne. She asks adventurers to locate Lothrius Mooncaller.

Sethekk Hollow is a swath of fetid pools into which lawbreaking residents of Skyreach are cast by the Adherents of Rukhmar. When winged arakkoa touch the waters of the Hollow, they are infected with the curse of Sethe, twisting their bodies into a hunched, flightless form and driving them to the brink of insanity. Only the powers of the dread raven god Anzu are able to restore the sanity of those arakkoa who are cast into the pools, and the Arakkoa Outcasts regularly attempt to save those they can from the maddening visions brought on by the curse. It was here that Terokk and his disciples, the first of the cursed arakkoa, were saved by Anzu and given not only the shadowy magic of the raven

Severed Essences can be found in the Spire of Icecrown Citadel. They are mirror images of players, summoned by s. They use various abilities from the classes of the players they mirror. As an interesting note, the essences also have some abilities that the classes do not use. One such case is the Radiance Aura ability for the paladin Severed Essence.

The Shado-Pan Monastery was the second announced 5-man dungeon of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria. Located in Kun-Lai Summit, this mountain retreat serves as the home and training grounds of the mysterious Shado-Pan, a pandaren faction dedicated to protecting Pandaria. Again, the Sha have been set free and threaten the Shado-pan's base of operations, and you’re tasked with dispatching them. ]] The monastery itself is located in the mountains of northwest Kun-Lai Summit, northwest of Mount Neverest and up the mountain path from Winter's Blossom. It can also be accessed via an unnamed path leading northwest from the Neverest Basecamp, skirting around the north of Mount Neverest. Outside t

The Sha'tari Market District is the commercial quarter of in Talador. The area has a working anvil, forge, and mailbox as well. The area is one of the main crossroads of Shattrath, connecting to the main city under the dome and connecting the Shattrath Commons to the main area of the outer city (labeled as "Shattrath City") near the Sha'tari Anchorage.

Shade of Terror is a conduit for warlocks. It drops from Timecap'n Hooktail in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market, Shriekwing in Castle Nathria, and Skolex in the Sepulcher of the First Ones. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthen the Bond, A Journey Made Together, Strengthening the Bond (Night Fae), and Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).

icon.]] The Forgotten Shadow is a powerful religion that sweeps through the Forsaken. A devotee may throw off the shackles of their zombie-like body, becoming one with the Shadow. Those who succeed become shadow ascendants. Outsiders do not understand the process that fuels the ascendant's evolution from a physically powerful but slow corpse to a quick and deadly shadow. The Cult of Forgotten Shadow, however, preaches that all Forsaken are born from the Shadow and that they carry a portion of the Shadow within them. By strengthening their ties to death and undeath, the ascendant manifests their inner Shadow, bonding with it until they become a living shadow, the ultimate manifestation of the

Shadow Dance is a rogue class talent. It is unique as a rogue ability in that it adds the ability to the rogue's Stance Bar, allowing configuration of the ability on a separate action bar. Subtlety rogues also learn it at level 22, allowing them to gain an additional charge by also taking it as a talent.

Shadow-Sage Iskar is an arakkoa formerly cursed by Sethe to be broken and flightless. He led his fellow Arakkoa Outcasts in the battle against Rukhmar and her Adherents. He later accepted an offer by Gul'dan to regain his flight using demonic magic in exchange for servitude to the Shadow Council. Iskar claims that he was born into the lowest caste in arakkoa society, although this is a lie; he was actually a priest of the Adherents before his fall.

Shadowmoon Deathshapers are fel orcs found in Gorefiend's Vigil in the Black Temple where they are working with the Shadowmoon Blood Mages on channeling something into skeletons. Killing a Shadowmoon Deathshaper will grant 15 reputation with Ashtongue Deathsworn.

Shadowcrawl is an ability for the Shadowfiend and Mindbender pets which can be summoned by a priest. When the pet uses this ability, it will teleport to the enemy target's location and gain 15% increased damage for 5 seconds. Shadowcrawl is set to autocast by default, and will be re-set to autocast each time the pet is summoned.
Shadowmoon Cultist Ring drops from Shadowmoon Ritualists and Shadowmoon Voidaxes in Tanaan Jungle.

Shadows of Ice is an original English manwha written by Richard A. Knaak and illustrated by Kim Jae-Hwan taking place in the Warcraft universe. Shadows of Ice is Volume 2 in The Sunwell Trilogy. *1 - Terror on the Mountain *2 - Baron Mordis *3 - Caverns of the Dead *4 - The Dwellers beneath *5 - The Orb of Ner'zhul *6 - Death on the Mountain

The Shadowsword were an organization of felblood elves loyal to Kael'thas Sunstrider and the Burning Legion. They used the Sunwell Plateau as their main headquarters, and some also resided in the Dawnblade-controlled Magister's Terrace. The Shadowsword were responsible for kidnapping M'uru from his secret chamber inside the Blood Knight headquarters in Silvermoon City. They battled against the heroes of the Shattered Sun Offensive that made it past the heightened Dawnblade forces inside the Sunwell Plateau. An enormous Shadowsword fel reaver guarded the hallway into the Sunwell itself.

The Shadowmoon Valley storyline takes place after completing the Alliance portion of the Warlords of Draenor intro experience in Tanaan Jungle. The main storyline is tracked in the quest achievement As I Walk Through the Valley of the Shadow of Moon. There are also a large number of vignettes in Shadowmoon Valley, as in all zones of Draenor.

Shadowmoon Treasure is found at in the largest hut near to the path up to Terrace of the Stars in southwest Anguish Fortress in western . It contains 40-50 Garrison Resources. It uses the same tracking quest as the Shadowmoon Sacrificial Dagger, so pick one or the other.
Shadowmoon Zealots are orc ghosts located in Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
Shadowmoon Summoning Ring drops from Shadowmoon Ritualists and Shadowmoon Voidaxes in Tanaan Jungle.
Shadowmoon Subjugator Ring drops from Shadowmoon Ritualists and Shadowmoon Voidaxes in Tanaan Jungle.

Shaman (sometimes pluralized as shamans) are mortal mediators between the very elements themselves. The shaman is a hybrid class, able to specialize in offensive spellcasting, melee damage dealing, or healing. As such, the class is considered highly adaptable and versatile, as shaman are formidable opponents, able to respond to any situation with a range of unique abilities. Often spiritual guides of their communities, these powerful practitioners commune with the ancestors and seek to balance the raging elemental forces. Shaman become deadly warriors, unstoppable spellcasters, and quick-witted healers by working respectfully with the elements. During combat, shaman place damaging and contro
Shaman abilities are abilities used by shaman. Most abilities are shared between all specializations, while some are only specific to one (or two) specializations.

Shale spiders are earth elemental creatures, with four spiderlike legs, that mostly only appear in Deepholm. The elemental shale spider is no true arachnid, but it has durability and ferocity that make it feared even in Deepholm. Like normal earth elementals, shale spiders are also capable of leaving the earth plane. Some of these creatures have appeared in the Twilight Highlands devouring Elementium, and others in The Jade Forest in Pandaria devour jade. Pandaren miners refer to them as "nibblers." Through experimentation, the mages of Dalaran have discovered that the powered remains of a crimson shale spider will greatly increase the conflagration of their fire spells. Adult amethyst shale

Shaol'mara is a small Zandalari town on a small island off to the southeast of the Isle of Thunder. The island is bordered by the Whispering Inlet and the Shadewood Thicket. After the Alliance claims Shaol'mara for the Kirin Tor Offensive, the Violet Rise phases in and replaces the area. Teleports from the Shado-Pan Garrison will go to the Violet Rise instead of The Seabolt.

The Shattered Strand is a coastal area in Azshara, lining the north side of the Bay of Storms. It is densely populated by hydras, sea giants, makrura and murlocs. The strand is also the location of the Temple of Arkkoran and the Tower of Eldara. With the events of the Shattering and the arrival of the goblins in Azshara, the once remote Shattered Strand became the site of many battles between the Bilgewater Battalion and the Spitelash naga. Some goblins also took advantage of the wealth of beach front property and engaged in real estate speculation here. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the strand falls under the Legion's control. Several naga were killed while the Horde troops continue
Shattrath City Peacekeepers are draenei guards of the Sha'tar located all throughout the capital of Shattrath City. They give directions to various locations within the city.

The Shepherd's Gate (or the Magister's Gate) serves as the main entry into Silvermoon from Eversong Woods. The Shepherd's Gate was not the original entrance to the city. Remnants of the original entry can be seen down the Dead Scar, and a large, sealed gate in the Bazaar blocks the path. This area remains inaccessible. It was named as such some time after the fall of Quel'Thalas in honor of Prince Kael who entered the ruined city some time after the Scourge invasion through this gate. In Year 25, the broken elf Galell hung a dealer named Orovinn upon the statue of Kael'thas.

Shattrath City has two inns, one on Aldor Rise, the other on Scryer's Tier. Shattrath City's main inn is located in the Lower City, but because of the large amounts of refugees, the inn has been converted into a shelter and the innkeeper redirects all those wanting a place to stay to head to Aldor Rise or Scryer's Tier.
Shattrath Flask of Supreme Power can be purchased for from: * in Shattrath City * in Shattrath City
Shatterspear Mystics are jungle trolls of the Shatterspear tribe found at the Shatterspear War Camp in Darkshore.
Shatterspear Champions are jungle trolls of the Shatterspear tribe found in the Shatterspear Vale in Darkshore.
Shatterspear Priestesses are jungle trolls of the Shatterspear tribe found in the Shatterspear Vale in Darkshore.
Shatterspear Raiders are jungle trolls of the Shatterspear tribe found in Shatterspear Vale in Darkshore.
Shattered Sun Clerics are blood elf and draenei paladins fighting for the Shattered Sun Offensive. They can be found mainly in Shattrath City.
Shattered Souls may refer to: * Shattered Souls (Havoc), the Havoc version. * Shattered Souls (Vengeance), the Vengeance version.

The Shattered River is a river in southern Nazmir, forming the border with Zuldazar and dividing the island of Zandalar in two by north and south. It was formed by the Cataclysm, which also shattered the Blood Gate that sits on the river.

Shimmering Silk Robes are sold by: * in Darnassus * in Thunder Bluff * in Undercity * in Undercity * in Ironforge * in Thunder Bluff * in Undercity * in Orgrimmar * in Thunder Bluff * in Thunder Bluff

The Shimmering Deep (or simply the Deep) is a massive lake, formerly Shimmering Flats until the Cataclysm shattered the mountain wall that separated the Shimmering Flats from the ocean. The gnomes and goblins working together built a Speedbarge and continue "working" relations with each other. Salvage operations for things lost to the Cataclysm take place in the Deep, some of them performed by Gazlowe. A crystal shard of Aramar Thorne's compass was located at the bottom. Some time after the Cataclysm, it was found by Aram and his group.

Shingo is a giraffe and is one of many animals featured in the Darkmoon Faire zoo on Darkmoon Island. Though classified as a giraffe, Shingo closely resembles an okapi. Shingo shares a spawn location within the same corral as Mabaka and Urefu.

__NOTOC__ The Shimmershade Garden (or Starlit Garden) is a small district located in the western portion of the nightborne Suramar City. It mainly consists of an open garden area with a fountain, shrubbery, and other flora native to Suramar. The garden is popular for relaxation and recreation among the city's citizens. Neighboring districts include the Artisan's Gallery to the south, Evermoon Commons to the east, and the Terrace of Order to the north.

Shifting Power is the mage class ability of the Night Fae Covenant. It's available to all mages who join the Night Fae. This ability is also temporarily available during the Ardenweald portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Preparing for the Winter Queen and lasts until you finish the Ardenweald storyline.

Shotoa was a tauren shaman. Shotoa lived sometime after the era of the War of the Three Hammers. He was blessed with a strong connection to the elements during his childhood. When Sorcerer-thane Thaurissan released Ragnaros and shattered the Redridge Mountains of the Eastern Kingdoms, the effects of the natural upheaval were felt as far as Kalimdor. Like the Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor was also suffering from natural disasters ranging from earthquakes to the land shattering apart. The Earthen Ring convened to discuss the effects of the natural upheaval and how to deal with the threat to their people. With the world being so chaotic, at times the elements had refused to answer the calls of the
Shooting Stars is a Balance druid talent. It gives Moonfire, Sunfire, and Stellar Flare a chance to deal additional damage and generate Astral Power.

The Shrine of Two Moons is an ancient mogu structure located north of Mogu'shan Palace in the eastern part of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. The Golden Lotus have allowed use of the shrine by the Horde, and it serves as the main hub for the faction in the continent of Pandaria, as opposed to the sanctuary cities serving as main hubs for both factions in previous expansions. The Alliance equivalent is the Shrine of Seven Stars and is on the opposite side of Mogu'shan Palace. The front of the building is The Golden Terrace, a large outside area separated into a lower section and an upper section. The lower section holds Pandaria faction representatives, challenge dungeon quests, and turn-in for

Silvermoon Guardians are wandering guards found patrolling Dawning Lane south to Falconwing Square, as well as the road between Fairbreeze Village and Farstrider Retreat in the blood elf starting zone of the Eversong Woods. They give directions to various locales within Eversong as well as some in Silvermoon City. Level 100 versions will spawn if any PvP-enabled NPCs are engaged within Eversong. During the Legion Invasions, some of them could spawn in the Northern Barrens to help their allies defend against the Burning Legion.
Silver Dress Robes are sold by: * in Darnassus * in Thunder Bluff * in Undercity * in Undercity * in Ironforge * in Thunder Bluff * in Undercity * in Orgrimmar * in Thunder Bluff * in Thunder Bluff

The Silvermoon's Pride is a blood elven destroyer moored to the docks at the Sun's Reach Harbor, Isle of Quel'Danas. It belongs to the Dawnblade, until the harbor is taken over by adventurers assisting the Shattered Sun Offensive. The ship itself is not yet seaworthy.

The Silver Enclave is the Alliance district of Dalaran and the headquarters of the Silver Covenant, a group of high elves opposing the inclusion of the blood elves into the Kirin Tor. When any Horde members approach the Enclave, they are immediately teleported away by the guards. The area is home to a Hero's Call Board, Class Trainers for all classes, a mailbox as well as Quartermasters for many Legacy currencies upstairs. This section of the city was renamed to the Greyfang Enclave after Dalaran teleported to the Broken Isles from Deadwind Pass during the third invasion of the Burning Legion.

__NOTOC__ The Silvermoon Magisters are two pairs of blood elves that can be found on the Horde side of Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula. The first two women have created a portal to Orgrimmar where reinforcements arrive to aid in the battle against the Burning Legion. Orgrimmar Grunts, Orgrimmar Shaman, Darkspear Axe Throwers and Undercity Mages, and from time to time, Melgromm Highmountain, all come out of the portal and rush to the base of the stairway to aid in the battle against the Burning Legion forces led by the Pit Commander. The two other magisters have created a portal to the Blasted Lands after the Dark Portal was closed down.

Silvermoon Dragonhawks are dragonhawks found in Eversong Woods and Ghostlands. They are also found within other blood elven settlements, such as Sunveil Excursion. Unlike most flight path beasts, they are always visibly present next to their flight master.
Silvermoon Finery is a clothing shop found in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City.
Silvermoon Alchemy is an alchemy and herbalism shop found in the Court of the Sun of Silvermoon City.
Silvermoon Jewelery is a jewelry shop found in the Royal Exchange of Silvermoon City.

__NOTOC__ Silvermoon Builders are blood elves found on the Isle of Quel'Danas, during the phased glimpse seen during the Quel'Delar quest chain. They are reconstructing the newly-reclaimed isle, found around the various villages and areas (such as Dawnstar Village) that were once controlled by the forces of Prince Kael'thas. Though the Shattered Sun Offensive has mostly vacated the isle, some members of the organization can be seen overlooking and assisting the builders in their work.
__NOTOC__ Silkworm Pupa is sold for (each) by: * in the Shrine of Two Moons * in the Shrine of Two Moons * in the Shrine of Seven Stars * in the Valley of the Four Winds
__NOTOC__ Silvermoon Blood Knights are troops from Silvermoon City following the Horde during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).

Silvermoon Citizens are Silvermoon City citizens appearing after the battle for the Broken Shore in Durotar and Orgrimmar. They are worried about the fate of their Warchief and can be seen discussing or crying with citizens from other Horde capitals.
Silvermoon Engineers are friendly blood elven engineers from Silvermoon City that are at the Legion Invasion locations. They are often found working on glaive throwers at blood elven military camps.

Silvermoon Arcanists are friendly blood elf mages from Silvermoon City that are at the Legion Invasion locations. Once saved, they can help the adventurers. They can only be saved by Horde adventurers.
Silvermoon Guards are two blood elves guarding a Portal to Silvermoon City in the Sunwell in the Sunwell Plateau when The Fall of the Sunwell scenario is finished.
Silvermoon Fireeaters were blood elves located in Silvermoon City. They were replaced by Master Flame Eaters.
Silvermoon Registry (or the Registrar of Guilds) is a visitor center found in Silvermoon City.
Silvermoon Valiants are the valiant challengers of the Horde faction Silvermoon City.
Silvermoon Priests are troops from Silvermoon City following Sylvanas Windrunner during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).

Sinister Strike (commonly abbreviated to SS) is a level 1 rogue ability. You must have a melee weapon equipped to use the ability. Sinister Strike can be used on any mob, in any position, in any combat state, and has no refresh rate beyond its energy requirement. You must be facing your target. This ability is replaced with Mutilate for Assassination rogues and Backstab for Subtlety rogues.

Singed Shamblers are bog beasts found at the remains of what was once the Iris Lake in Ashenvale. Before the Shattering they were known as Shadethicket Moss Eaters. It would seem that during the eruption of Thunder Peak the lava didn't destroy them, but rather imbued the with fiery abilities.

__NOTOC__ Sister Almyra is a human priest trainer first seen in Gilneas City and later moves with the other Gilnean citizens to Darnassus. She is a member of the clergy in the kingdom. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she treated Desperate Darnassian Citizens in the Temple of the Moon and was later evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.

Siren's Vigil is a small district located in the southwest corner of the nightborne city of Suramar. It can be found on the city's lower levels, and borders two other residential districts in the form of the Evermoon Commons and Starcaller Retreat across the canals to the east and north respectively. Siren's Vigil has significant access to Suramar Bay, which surrounds much of the district, and possesses two separate jetties for accommodating transport boats. The commune is also notable for housing a school for nightborne children, including a classroom and an outdoor playground.

Skettis is the hidden capital of the arakkoa, and one of the major secrets of Terokkar Forest. It was built among Apexis ruins six hundred years before the opening of the Dark Portal by Terokk, the Talonpriests, and Anzu. It is one of the last remaining portions of the Spires of Arak in Outland and was built by the ancient king Terokk as a refuge for those outcast and unwanted in arakkoa society. After the flying arakkoa died in Draenor's destruction, it became the capital of the arakkoa as a whole. It is situated in Blackwind Valley in southeastern Terokkar Forest, only accessible to players who have a flying mount or Druids who have learned Flight Form. It is made up of four Veils: Veil Al

The Skethyl Mountains are located in southeastern Terokkar Forest. They contain the large Blackwind Valley and its main features - Blackwind Lake and the arakkoa capital, Skettis. The mountains are only traversible for players who have flight.

Skelton Isle is an island where Pirate-King Zem'lan left guards many millennia ago who still continue to guard the island. The island is found with Zem'lan's Lost Treasure Map and a mission is sent to take the Stalwart Worldvein.
*Sketh'lon Base Camp, located southeast of the Wildhammer Stronghold in southwestern Shadowmoon Valley. *Sketh'lon Wreckage, located southeast of Shadowmoon Village in northwestern Shadowmoon Valley.

Skyrange is the high ridge extending southward from the mountain range border of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms in northwest Valley of the Four Winds. It is only accessible with a flying mount. Skyrange overlooks the western end of the Heartland to the east and the Singing Marshes and Paoquan Hollow to the west. On the northern end of Skyrange is Kunzen Village and the Kunzen Cave. Several Stout Shaghorns gather in herds to graze on the mountain alongside the Skyrange Mushan. Just south of the Kunzen Village is a hozen ritual area where Kunzen Ritualists are found performing rituals. Kunzen Hunters are found roaming the cliffs, while the Hunter-Chief is found at the far south. There are some T

Skydancer Shun is a riding trainer located on the Golden Terrace of the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He is riding a jade cloud serpent. He is the primary trainer for the Horde capable of teaching Wisdom of the Four Winds, which allows flying in Pandaria. The only other trainer that teaches the skill is Cloudrunner Leng, who is his counterpart at the Alliance's Shrine of Seven Stars.

The Skybag is a zeppelin flying above the Brawl'gar Arena, offering a view on the on-going brawls. The Skybag teleporter is located just outside of the Brawl'gar Arena bar. To use the teleporter, you must either be Rank 6 in Brawl'gar Arena, or someone must purchase a Zeppelin Rental Form from Tiana Nevermorn.

Sleep effects cause a standing sleep-like state, where the character is unable to act for the duration of the ability. However, any damage taken by the target will break the effect. Examples of abilities that cause Sleep effect: * Druid: Hibernate * Hunter: Wyvern Sting * Various items can also cause the Sleep effect, like Slumber Sand. Any sleep effect, no matter the duration listed, will last a maximum of 8 seconds when used against players in PvP. In PvP, sleep effects are also subject to diminishing returns. Note that Rogue's Gouge and Sap abilities, along with a Succubus's Seduction are functionally equivalent to sleep effects, that is, they prevent the target from taking any action for
Skywrath is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Falling Star (druid artifact trait), New Moon (artifact trait), and Scythe of the Stars traits.

Whenever a Monk equips Swords, the monk passive Fighting Style causes his or her Jab ability to change into the Slice ability. This is a flavor change only and does not affect the cost or damage of the Jab ability.
Smack is a basic primary hunter pet ability that does damage, along with Claw (pet ability) and Bite. It scales with attack power.

Slyhoof the Shameless Shaman is a Highmountain tauren vendor found in a hut find just east of the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. He sells various cosmetic items and toys, perhaps most notably a set of totems themed after the four Highmountain tribes which, when used, apply a cosmetic buff which creates large totems on the character's back.

__NOTOC__ Smoot is a goblin running at high speeds around Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara. Fleep tasked him with inventing an Induction Samophlange, but he subsequently went drunk with power and now runs around town with his :samophlange held high while proclaiming how much he loves it. Adventurers need to tackle him unconscious and steal the samophlange from him for the quest Smoot's Samophlange. Smoot runs around the western half of the island by the vendors. The best way to find Smoot is to type /target Smoot and fly around. Alternatively, one can stand in front of the inn where the class trainers are dueling one another, since he will eventually run past it.
Smoldering Hero: Dragonflight Season 2 is a feat of strength achievement earned by ending Dragonflight Mythic+ Season 2 with a Mythic+ Rating in the top 0.1% of all players in the region.

Snowmane Village is a small village in the Snowblind Mesa in eastern Highmountain. At some point, it was attacked by members of the Feltotem tribe. It also came under attack when drogbar loyal to Dargrul the Underking launched an attack on Snowblind Mesa. Mayla Highmountain and her allies came to Snowmane Village's aid, combatting the drogbar and helping to evacuate civilians. At least one civilian refused to leave, as he believed the drogbar were poorly armed and didn't stand a chance against the tauren. Much of the village was ultimately destroyed when Dargrul arrived and used the :Hammer of Khaz'goroth against it.
Solar Collectors are devices used by the Suntouched Acolytes in Uldum during Assault: Amathet. Adventurers need to power all Power Crystals in order to destroy the collectors.

It is instant-cast, with a 4-second cooldown. Rank 5 of this ability also reduces the target's melee attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.

These female Magi, sent by the Magocrats of Dalaran to watch over the volatile Battle Magi, use their arcane powers to aid the Alliance forces whenever Humanity is imperiled. Although their powers are not often used directly in combat, the Sorceresses are able to aid the Alliance warriors with a wide array of specialized conjurings and magical effects.

Soulguard Watchmen can be found in groups of two in the Forge of Souls. These terrifying bone giants belonging to the Cult of the Damned serve as the first line of defense against those who would dare infiltrate the Forge of Souls. Their creators have granted them the runic ability to reflect spells at their attackers. When attacked, they may also fly into an unholy rage increasing their power and speed.

Soulbinder Nyami is one of several Auchenai soul priests encountered in . Initially loyal to the Exarch Council, she is revealed to be an agent of the Burning Legion, working to subvert the Draenei's efforts in both the Shadowmoon Valley storyline and Talador storyline before making her last stand in . She wielded powerful shadow magic.

Southbreak Shore in Tanaris is an expanse of flat beach to the south of Lost Rigger Cove. It is quiet and almost deserted apart from the pirates that have taken over the northern section of the beach. From here Captain Dreadbeard commands the local pirates and has begun getting aid from sea giants, though unclear how. The hostile turtles and sea giants that roamed the surf has moved on and in their place Duneshore Crabs now skitter around. Just off the coast lies a small island with a lone gnome named Winkey. A spell is the caster's stock-in-trade. Spells are magic incantations or effects conjured up by whatever game mechanism the developers allowed. Supposedly modeled after fantasy, myth, and legend, spells have various effects. Spells can do different kinds of damage, or healing. They can also cause beneficial effects (aka buffs) on friendly characters, or harmful effects (aka debuffs) on hostile mobs. Within Wowpedia, spells are distinguished from abilities and powers. Spells are also used in many different ways depending upon which game (World of Warcraft vs. other Warcraft games) one is playing.

Spell Lock is a warlock Felhunter ability granted by Command Demon. When used while the target is in the process of casting a spell, the target will be unable to cast a spell from the same school of magic for 6 seconds. This is an instant-cast ability with a 24-second cooldown, and is learned automatically by the Felhunter at level 50.
The Spellstrike Hood is a power caster head item that boosts spell haste, spell critical strike rating, and overall magical power.
The Spellstrike Pants are power caster leg items that boost spell hit rating, spell critical strike rating, and overall magical power.

Bonuses for Spell power can only be obtained through Red gems, Orange gems, Purple gems, and Meta gems. As of 3.0.2, bonuses for Healing were removed from the game, and combined/replaced with a blanket Spell power stat. In patch 4.0.1, spell power was removed from the game and replaced by intellect.

Sporeling Refugees are one of the many different kinds of refugees found living in the lower part of Shattrath City. These refugees wander around the city trying to make a living and begin a new life after escaping from the dangers that threatened their lives daily in Zangarmarsh. There are about a dozen of Sporelings living in the city.

The Stalkers are named elite Horde guards in Dazar'alor that patrol the city. They can detect stealthed enemies and upon discovering one, attack them, alerting the city to its presence. Their patrol is on a set route that take them throughout a majority of the city.

Steady Shot is a hunter ability, available starting at level 1. Beyond level 10, this ability is only relevant to the Marksmanship specialization. For Beast Mastery, it's quickly replaced by the Cobra Shot talent. For Survival, it has no utility and can't be used without swapping weapons in combat, as most of the spec's major abilities require a melee weapon, not a ranged one.

Starseekers are a faction within the night elves, they fought alongside the demigod Cenarius with the Shadowleaves, Nightblades, and Moonhunters against Grom Hellscream and the Warsong clan. The Nightblades destroyed the first Warsong base and the Starseekers established there, from which they sent periodic attacks against the Warsong clan. However when Grom found the Chaos Well, he and his orcs drank from it and became chaos orcs. With their burst of power they attacked the night elves and killed Cenarius himself.
The Star of Xil'yeh is a powerful gem that grants its holder the power to speak to beings on other worlds.

Starcaller Retreat is a district located in the southwest section of the nightborne city of Suramar. Found in the city's lower levels, the district borders other suburban areas in the form of the Evermoon Commons and Siren's Vigil to the east and south, and the Artisan's Gallery to the north. It is a largely open district with a main square and access to Suramar Bay. The Starcaller Retreat is notably home to the Waning Crescent, an outdoor tavern that acted as a major focal meeting point for much of Suramar's citizenry. Stone Cairn Lake is situated in northeastern Elwynn Forest, and holds one large island that gives the lake a characteristic ring shape. The lake is named after Heroes' Vigil, the stone cairn monument erected upon the island to commemorate the huge loss of life during the First War against the orcs. While the lake has previously been a safe place to make pilgrimages to, it has now fallen into the hands of Rogue Wizards who have settled on the island. The water also holds a tribe of murlocs who have raised crude structures on the southern banks of the lake. This area has possibly the highest concentration of Copper in Elwynn.

The Stormcoil Commander is a naga who orchestrates the Stormcoil army during its invasion of the Shrouded Shore in Vol'dun during Wrath of the Tiger. He is never directly seen, and his only presence is in the form of his yelled commands. He initially orders the Stormcoil to destroy the temple of the loa Eraka no Kimbul and is incredulous when the Avatar of Kimbul begins slaughtering the Stormcoil forces. Eventually, he is forced to declare the battle lost and order the Stormcoil to retreat to the safety of the ocean after it becomes clear that the loa is too powerful.

The Stormreaver clan was a small but powerful orcish clan created by Gul'dan at the onset of the Second War. Most of the clan was destroyed when Gul'dan ventured to the Tomb of Sargeras in search of the power therein, being either torn apart by the demons dwelling in the Tomb or slaughtered by the Black Tooth Grin forces sent to exact vengeance on Gul'dan for abandoning the Horde during its critical time. Its clan colors was blue.

The mighty Stormwind Keep (also called Stonewind Keep, Castle Stormwind, stronghold of Stormwind, Stormwind Castle, and after its reconstruction sometimes referred as Castle of New Stormwind) is the seat of power of the human kingdom of Stormwind. This keep is the residence of the Stormwindian kings, currently King Anduin Wrynn. The royal court as well as some of the nobles of the kingdom are also here. The Keep offers a view of the whole city, so that the king can watch over the masses, and provide a powerful reminder of what deserves to be defended. Stormwind City Patrollers are wandering guards located throughout the human capital of Stormwind City. They can provide directions to various locations in town. During the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth, the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city, and the guards were on high alert.

The Stormwind Lake is the most prominent feature of a new park-like district in Stormwind City opened in the northeastern part of the city, behind the Cathedral of Light. The Stormwind City Cemetery surrounds the northern part of the lake.
Stormwind Surprise was sold by Rona Greenteeth on Darkmoon Island during the Darkmoon Faire for .
Strength of Earth Totem is a shaman Earth totem that increases the Strength and Agility of all party and raid members within 40 yards. It grants 549 Strength and Agility at level 85.

The Strange Winged Goblin is a goblin Cupid who could be found during the Love is in the Air event in the Exodar, Shattrath City and Silvermoon City. Unlike his cousin Kwee Q. Peddlefeet, he is not a quest giver. He tells you where you can find his cousin, which seems to be his only role.

Strength of Wrynn is zone-wide raid buff granted to all Alliance players in Icecrown Citadel which increases health, healing done and damage done. The first level of Strength of Wrynn was activated on March 2, 2010 - 1 month after The Lich King became available. This buff was released at 5%, however it has increased in power over time.

Today, Stratholme is the Scourge's capital in Lordaeron. The mad Prince Arthas ravaged Stratholme in the Third War and the undead moved in soon after. Stratholme burns to this day.

Two are located in the Hall of the Seasons, the ground level, on either side of the statue of Liu Lang and Shen-zin Su. Terokkar Refuge is an outpost of the Arakkoa Outcasts, located on Duskfall Island south of in Talador. The Outcasts have settled on the island after being forced from their homes in Veil Shadar by the Adherents of Rukhmar, the flying arakkoa who seek to exterminate their cursed brethren.

Terrorweb Tunnel is a long and winding tunnel into the mountain northwest of Terrordale. It is full of crypt fiends (nerubians), and stretches through the mountain from Terrordale in the north and extends south to the Thondroril River. Tirion Fordring was located at the entrance from the river. One must be very careful when traveling this path, as not only is this path crowded with many Crypt Fiends, but occasionally a very powerful and elite member of its kind, the Nerubian Overseer, stalks the tunnel.

Thaelis the Hungerer is the Wretched ringleader residing in the Commons Hall in Eversong Woods. He's wanted for repeated crimes against the populace of Silvermoon City including the murder of two city guards. A bill was posted for his head by Sergeant Kan'ren at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.

He only appears during the height of winter and probably lives on a seasonal hibernation cycle. When he does appear, however, he must satiate a savage hunger and constantly scrounges for food. He is known to attack travelers passing through the mountains, taking their entire food supply. Since the employees of Smokywood Pastures make use of the mountain routes to transport their goods, they are often hindered by the Greench's annual awakening and lose some amount of their rations to his voracious appetite. The cipher is seen during quests in Shadowmoon Valley and the alternate timeline Tanaan Jungle. The cipher is ancient; the Apexis had writings about it located in Kra'nak.

The Immortal is a title awarded when you complete the achievement The Immortal (achievement). Raid members must slay all the bosses in Naxxramas on Heroic, during one lockout period, without any raid members dying during any of the boss encounters. The Magic Seeker title is the reward for completing the Feat of Strength Realm First! Magic Seeker, being the first on a realm to slay Malygos on heroic difficulty.

The Orbs are powerful minor artifacts of unknown origin. Though each is a fist-sized gem that grants the wielder a similar set of magical enhancement, the various types have their own particular power associated with them.

The Ook of Dook is a hozen found at Dooker Dome in Kun-Lai Summit. He is the new chief of the Knucklethump tribe and leader of the mountain hozen tribes. He is chief because he has gathered the grummles' supplies. He also used his yeti pet, Chomp Chomp, to scare other hozen in to making him the leader hozen. He trained the Broketooth tribe to use their big magic idols to get power from sacrifices such as grummles. Eventually, the grummles retaliated with the help of the Alliance and Horde, scaring Chomp Chomp away, and attacking the Ook of Dook.

The Netherstar is found inside a Korthian Relic Box at hidden under a ledge on the northwest side ofthe Estuary of Awakening. Open the chest with the Key of Flowing Waters, purchased for 25x Cataloged Research at Tier 2 with the Archivists' Codex from Archivist Roh-Suir. The netherstar starts the The Netherstar quest, one of many relics for Reliquary Restoration.

The Power in Our Hands is the Artifact capstone quest. Note that artifacts will be overpowered by this quest - all traits will be active until the release of 8.0. Don't be afraid to complete the quest for fear of losing power!

The Power of Elune is the climax of the "The Power of Night" chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign. Ysera and the Maw Walker have gathered three Night Warriors from across the Shadowlands in the Grove of Awakening of Ardenweald in an attempt to save Tyrande Whisperwind from Elune's power before it kills her.

The Spirit of Gnomeregan is a flying machine located at the Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin and serves as a flight master. It is only available after completing the quest Have a Part, Give a Part. The plane's name is a reference to Gnomeregan, the overrun home city of the gnomish race.

The Waning Crescent is a tavern located in the Starcaller Retreat district of the nightborne Suramar City. The establishment itself contains an enclosed courtyard with several storerooms and other buildings forming a small compound. It can be found just off the main square of Starcaller Retreat. Tidecaller Nezara is the leader of the Nazeshi naga in the Dreadpearl Shallows in Zuldazar during the vulpera recruitment questline. Accompanied by a Nazeshi Tidebreaker, she is initially protected by a magical barrier powered by powercells scattered around the area. After disrupting the naga around the shallows and taking down Nezara's shield, Nisha and the Horde adventurer attack and kill her, ending the Nazeshi threat to the coast.

Timely Arrival is a quest to escort Sentinel Aynasha to the dock of Shatterspear War Camp in Darkshore. It becomes available by killing Rit'ko for One Bitter Wish, then looting the Shatterspear Torturer's Cage Key from him to open the Shatterspear Cage holding Aynasha. However, the cage is bugged and will remain open if the quest fails. Aynasha will not offer the quest if you can't interact with the cage, and the only solution is to wait for dailies to reset. Another solution would be to use the Group Finder to look for a server where the cage is closed. This quest can be accepted while in a raid.

Tiragarde Sound is the largest and most central of the three major regions of Kul Tiras. Mountainous and rugged, the region is divided in two by a massive bay that opens into the Great Sea. Tiragarde Sound is host to the Kul Tiran capital city of Boralus and thus serves as the seat of power for the ruling House Proudmoore. Its citizens retain a strong maritime tradition and hail from a wide range of backgrounds, from monster hunters and pirates to noblemen and tidesages.
To Catch Falling Stars is a feat of strength achievement earned by being the proud owner of the 2022 Vintage Winter Veil gift, Falling Star Catcher.

Touch of the Moon is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Dark Side of the Moon (druid artifact trait), Light of the Sun (artifact trait), and Power of Goldrinn (artifact trait) traits.

After being exiled from the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City, he took up residence here to continue his study of the dark arts. At some point, Morganth was replaced by Grand Magus Doane, who is actually the black dragon Darkblaze.

Training points, or "TP's", were points earned by Hunter pets and spent on training pet abilities. Pets earned points by leveling and growing more loyal to their hunter master. Training points were used to "spec" the pet in various ways, including passive modifications such as Cobra Reflexes, Avoidance, increased Armor, Health and Resistances, as well as active abilities, such as Growl, Cower, and other various beast abilities. Hunter pets could be untrained of all their skills from any beast trainer in the major cities. Similar to talents, untraining a specific pet scaled up as you do it more times: 10 silver, 50 silver, 1 gold, 2 gold, 3 gold, etc., eventually stopping at 10 gold.

Trainee Firea is blood elf rogue located in the Students of Shadow in the Murder Row in Silvermoon City. Along with fellow trainee Alcor, she's practicing her abilities under the direction of Instructor Cel.

Trand can be found at the Prepfoot Compound in the northeastern cliffs of Highmountain, standing before Wu'de, Lisy and Darsa Prepfoot and offering to hold sermons for adventurers who find their way to the compound.

The Troll Destroyers are swift, ill-visaged longboats designed to cut through enemy armadas and deal damage to enemy vessels and their flying support. The savage Troll crewmen are eager to enter into combat against Alliance ships of war and hungrily await any chance to stand mast to mast against the Elven Destroyers.

Troyas Moonbreeze is a night elf quest giver located at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. He had a pet cat named Jewel. He has been missing since the Cataclysm after the Hatecrest naga invaded Feathermoon Isle, possibly having been killed in the attack.
Turtle Rock is island somewhere on Azeroth. Once an island for all those who were exiled, this has now become an island of riches for those who seek its hidden treasures.

Illidan Stormrage, during his rule over the Black Temple, sent his forces to close other portals in Outland, which cut off the flow of demons and ended the extra stresses on the planet's remnants. The gateway still exists; however, it is no longer functional. This area was once the palace-city of Highmaul. It is the location of the ancient dwarven fortress, Grim Batol, and also houses a majority of Twilight's Hammer settlements, working with Deathwing and his black dragonflight. There is a small red dragonflight presence. The story of the twilight dragonflight unfolds in this zone. The famous region of Northeron was once the northern part of the Highlands.

The Twilight Vineyards are a large plantation and arcwine production center in the northeast of the nightborne capital of Suramar City. The vineyard specializes nearly exclusively in the creation of arcwine, an alcoholic beverage imbued with the energies of the Nightwell, and consumed by the entire nightborne population in order to satisfy their addiction to magic. As such, the facility's importance to the city is exceptional, for if a nightborne is starved of the energies provided by the arcwine, they will wither away and begin to lose their very minds. The road from Feralas to Desolace runs between these two mountains. (Some individuals conjecture that these are the stumps of what were once trees that have since eroded and become indiscernible from the surrounding rock and dirt) The two mesas are one of the most striking landmarks of the area and inspire awe in whoever beholds them.
